name: storage-r2
title: Storage: Cloudflare R2
description: Implements lib/storage/* with Cloudflare R2 (S3 API, presigned direct uploads). Requires env R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET, optional R2_PUBLIC_URL. Bucket needs a CORS rule allowing PUT from the app origin. Replaces the base stubs: install with --overwrite.
docs: Add a CORS rule to the R2 bucket: [{"AllowedOrigins":["http://localhost:3000","https://YOUR-APP.vercel.app"],"AllowedMethods":["PUT","GET"],"AllowedHeaders":["*"],"MaxAgeSeconds":3600}]. R2_PUBLIC_URL is optional (custom domain / r2.dev); without it, getFileUrl returns 1h presigned GET URLs.
